candidates.reason: One of the longest waits to cross in the study area: 60 s (level of service F) across 1,648 veh/h on Queensferry Street. Signals give people on foot their own phase.
One of the most overloaded streets in the study area: its busiest direction carries 1,526 veh/h at 153% of capacity (08:00-09:00 weekday). A bus lane gives half its car capacity to buses.

Named in consultation material for rat running (CMP You Said We Did v2, para 3.32: named as a priority, no count of comments given), and carries 966 veh/h in the model. Closing it to through traffic answers the complaint.
